Key.English:
Draw the camera picture on the Spectrum
Device's own screen, next to its compass.
The carried monitor stays away.

Off: the picture goes on the monitor
instead, like the Optiwand.

Hold the left mouse button to bring the
picture up, using the device's own transmit
bar.

Off: the picture is there the moment the
camera is deployed.

Seconds of holding before the picture
appears.

Letting go drains twice as fast, so tapping
gets you nowhere.

Gooseneck inspection camera for the
Spectrum Device. Fits the muzzle slot
in place of an antenna.

Aim the device to deploy it, same as the
Optiwand. No signal tracking while fitted.
